pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:0.5: Ime kho pan' ayyāyo aṭṭha pāṭidesaniyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.5: kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ kassa sāduṃ na ruccatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ mānussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, paṭidesetabbaṃ tāya bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.16: gārayhaṃ ayye dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesaniyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.1.17: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.2: gilānapucchikā bhikkhuniyo gilānā bhikkhuniyo etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.3: kacci ayye khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.4: pubbe mayaṃ ayye sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjāma, tena no phāsu hoti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.5: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittan ti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema, tena no na phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānāya bhikkhuniyā sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.8: evañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.9.1: yā pana bhikkhunī agilānā sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, paṭidesetabbaṃ tāya bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:1.2.10: gārayhaṃ ayye dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesaniyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemīti. ||2||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:2.1.8: yassā vinā sappinā na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:2.1.10: gosappi vā ajikāsappi vā māhisaṃ vā sappi, yesaṃ maṃsaṃ kappati tesaṃ sappi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:2.1.11: agilānā attano atthāya viññāpeti, payoge dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pd1:2.2.1: agilānā agilānasaññā sappiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjati, āpatti pāṭidesaniyassa.
